title: Legume lessons: structural and functional advancements in Nod Factor Receptors for translating root nodule symbiosis
content: The ViewPoint summarises recent findings pertaining to the functionality of legume Nod Factor Receptors (NFRs) that have helped in receptor engineering of LysM-Receptor-Like Kinases (LysM-RLKs) in non-nodulating crop plants.
siteTitle: Journal of Experimental Botany Current Issue
